stepTitle: The response bias of the updated survey is likely $$___the$$ response bias of the original survey.
stepBody: Assume that Josh could go back in time and make both updates suggested by Jake, and no other changes, where the two updates are: emailing an SRS of $$200$$ UC Berkeley student emails instead of $$100$$, and sending a reminder email to all students who did not open the initial email within one week.
